people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.
translations.bsb: Though the river rages, Behemoth is unafraid; he remains secure, though the Jordan surges to his mouth.
translations.kjv: Behold, he drinketh up a river, and hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.
translations.asv: Behold, if a river overflow, he trembleth not; He is confident, though a Jordan swell even to his mouth.
